links.outcome: Zero-shot LLM stunting prediction performance and fairness across sex, residence, and wealth subgroups
links.effect: Performance was relatively consistent across child sex groups, but important fairness disparities were observed across residence and household wealth categories.
links.quote: however, important fairness disparities were observed across residence and household wealth categories, highlighting the need for further investigation before deployment of foundation models in public health prediction settings.

screen.reason: Empirically benchmarks zero-shot LLM performance, demographic fairness, and temporal robustness for child stunting prediction on retrospective survey data without evaluating a specific deployment safeguard or intervention.
